source.note: Search summary: 280 hectares (kept in this note) and 8 lifts in total, including high-speed six-seat and quad chairs and surface lifts; another line in the same summary said '3 chairlifts and 3 express chairlifts', so the lift-type split is left unknown. Season id 2025-26.

Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'. Night skiing on selected evenings in mid-winter is a long-running Coronet Peak feature (reference — confirm 2027 dates).

character: Queenstown's closest ski area, on the slopes above Arthurs Point, operated by NZSki and included on the Ikon Pass. A new Snow Factory was set to open early-season terrain from 29 May 2026, and the mountain is known for its mid-winter night skiing.
learning: Reference note: learner areas and an NZSki snowsports school are at the base; confirm 2027 lesson products and prices.

source.note: Winter 2026: early-season opening 29 May – 12 Jun 2026 on Snow Factory terrain, full mountain from 13 Jun subject to conditions (resort early-season guide — a planned date; the actual opening was not independently confirmed). Closing: scheduled Sun 4 Oct 2026 (shared research notes, https://www.onthesnow.com/new-zealand/projected-closing) — still ahead on 2026-09-30. Planned closing day 2026-10-04 (not yet happened as of 2026-09-30).
Winter 2025 published season dates: 14 Jun – 28 Sep 2025 (scheduled dates; actual days may have differed).

season.typicalText: Usually mid-June to late September or early October; in 2026 a new Snow Factory added an early start planned for 29 May.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30 (NZSki's 2027 3 Peak Pass was still listed as 'Coming Soon' — https://www.theremarkables.co.nz/passes-packages/). OnTheSnow labels the 2026 NZ winter '2026/2027', so its 'projected' dates describe winter 2026, not 2027.

prices.note: Same price weekday and weekend per the search summary; the season was not stated (most likely the 2026 winter). Half-day adult NZ$135.

moreLinks.label: Ikon Pass (the 2026-27 pass covers the 2027 NZ winter)
